notes:
Probe script: /Users/miguel/.julia/dev/Redstone.jl/design/reports/20261124_doc_conformance/probes/CV12/probe.jl, run 4 times. IDs run CV12-001 to CV12-155 across rows and ok.

Scope. I took out functions whose comments cite §13 or §14 (init!, checkpoint, run!, step!, replay!, lifecycle, termination, the §13.5 sources, _advance!, _run_body!, attach!, trace, and the like). Rows on those exist only for the lead list (Simulation, trim!, linearize) and the map.

Leads. Five became findings: Simulation, overlay!, restore!, trim!, linearize each have keywords on the signature that no `# Keywords` bullet lists. The replay! lead and the step! lead are ok, because their combined bullets name every keyword. The Simulation row is low weight, since docstring_rules.md rule 11 lets forwarded keywords sit in the signature alone.

Counts. The counts are by question (docstring, surface, map, cite), not by law/mech/decl. The slice is code-to-docs, so no claim came from spec prose.

Not covered by the findings. Rows under kind map and cite cover helpers and citations I checked; the 19 cite claims group citations by function. D-273 on overlay! and §7.3 on port/state/modes are borderline cites. The ModelState origin check (ArgumentInvalid :range on t0, src/model.jl:1264) appears in Appendix C but not in the restore! docstring. I did not report it, because only a hand-built state reaches it.
